title: Restrictions: Applications
description: Allows or blocks apps by path or bundle ID (legacy Parental Controls application restrictions).

allowList.title: Allow list
allowList.description: The allow list of app item dictionaries.

appID.title: app ID
appID.description: The identifier of the app. Obtain this value from the Security framework using SecCodeCopyDesignatedRequirement.

bundleID.title: Bundle ID
bundleID.description: The bundle ID of the app.

detachedSignature.title: Detached signature
detachedSignature.description: The signature for an unsigned binary.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: If true, this app isn't added to the allow list.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: The name used for display purposes.

subApps.title: Sub apps
subApps.description: An array of nested helper applications.
